decision: Shelve the fixed six-antigen RNA allocation question; no publication-worthy finding survives this panel.
validity: All six fixed genes across704 source RNA columns (all13EMC/nine known-nonoverlap primary rows), all42 array conditions (sixEMC), all16 old-ratio conditions (tenEMC), all four3SEQ EMC conditions/6MLPS/3SS/27normal and three authenticated cultures independently match retained originals. Half-tie rank A, all13/deletion checks, within-year pair weighting, Mann-Whitney/IUT/Holm6 and frozen allocation gates pass. Current RefSeq association corrected before accepted model results.
uncertainty: Owner conditional bootstrap interval bounds checked; bootstrap draws not independently regenerated. Source-year and donor overlap remain unresolved; nine retained rows are not proven independent donors. Normal organs/age/assays unmatched. Units and technical conditions not pooled.
strongest_surviving_observation: ERBB2 and MET have appreciable bulk RNA but fail the required sarcoma-comparator/cross-assay contrast. FOLR1 high cases are retained but low median/contrary arrays and published prior outliers remove a new broad allocation finding.
value: No candidate passes the frozen useful RNA contrast. PVRL4 annotation recovery, FDA roster and primary omission corrections are useful reproducibility records, not a new standalone EMC biological finding. Failed operational thresholds cannot support a negative ADC efficacy/protein paper.
primary_source_omissions: Existing author-labelled T-DXd EMC enrollment must remain visible, with treatment status/IHC/response mapping unresolved; Davis FOLR1 two outliers/five QC-passing cases are prior art; plasma TF microvesicles are not tumor tissue protein; six breast-review negative rows include a confirmed metaplastic mimic and unresolved molecular identities, with no authenticated6/21 denominator. SAMBA and c-Met source gaps retained.
coverage_status: Incomplete full public EMC evidence. Suitable accessible measurements in other identified public sources and case-linked trial/protein evidence remain pending; source unavailability, unknown mapping and measured zero remain distinct. No positive or universal-negative promotion permitted.
reopening_conditions: Authenticated EMC tumor-cell membrane measurements with relevant mimic/normal comparisons that answer a useful question beyond existing outlier/trial prior art.

Complete patient-linked T-DXd/c-Met evidence or broader EMC transcript measurements may revise source interpretation; any new claim must prospectively define its useful contrast and complete relevant eligible evidence.
